An '''Imperial scientist''' on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], this [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] became infected with the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]] [[virus]] when crates containing the contagion were breached in the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], and proceeded to decimate the entire crew. He was transformed into a [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] along with the rest of the crew.

The [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] later found [[Zahara Cody]] of the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] in [[Bio-Lab 242]] of the [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]. He grabbed her and she stabbed him in the [[Eye/Legends|eye]] with a syringe filled with the recently-engineered vaccine to the virus. This caused him to scream loudly, as the vaccine restored a tiny amount of his former awareness, during which he proceeded to attempt to communicate with her, first by attempting speech, which came out as gibberish, before attempting to write on the floor with a syringe. Within minutes however, the vaccine's effectiveness diminished, reverting him back to his feral zombie condition. He attacked her afterwards, but was killed for good when a nearby [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] rammed a surgical [[Bone/Legends|bone]] saw in to the top of his head.
